actions.name: RAUM_PNL_COST_HISTORY
actions.validation: SELECT-only stored CostPrice by active settlement + selected OrderYear + PartnerCode; same product and unit; browser comparison only

actions.name: RAUM_PNL_PURCHASE_COST_EDIT
actions.validation: explicit OrderYear+PartnerCode+MajorWeek+PnlKey and shared product identity; all-or-nothing optimistic snapshot; 0 preserved and empty becomes NULL

actions.name: RAUM_PNL_MATCH_DISPLAY
actions.validation: show Product.ProdName for WebRaumPnlItem.ProdKey; unmatched visible

actions.name: RAUM_PNL_MONTHLY_SUMMARY
actions.validation: QuoteDate YYYY-MM; aggregate stored week summaries

actions.name: RAUM_PNL_ASSIGN_MONTH

crossYearFixture.description: 같은 라움 차수와 품목이 2025·2026에 있어도 주문등록과 결산 저장은 선택한 OrderYear를 유지한다.

costComparison.preview: purchase-cost input hover/focus shows nearby viewport-clamped portal preview from the SAME costComparison matrix; Escape dismisses; no additional requests or writes; excluded from print
costComparison.source: WebRaumPnlItem.CostPrice, not arrival reference price or WebRaumCostPrice latest learned value
costComparison.scope: active WebRaumPnl, exact selected OrderYear and PartnerCode; latest MajorWeek first
costComparison.identity: positive ProdKey + normalized Unit; if both rows lack ProdKey, exact whitespace-normalized ItemName + Unit; custom rows kept separate
costComparison.missing: null/empty is absent; explicit zero remains zero; differing prices within one week are all shown without averaging
costComparison.refresh: detail open, partner/year change, successful settlement save, explicit retry; stale responses ignored
costComparison.export: comparison excluded from Excel and print; existing calculation and export payloads unchanged

purchaseCostManagement.display: rows are product identity and columns are active stored settlements for exact selected OrderYear+PartnerCode; each cell also shows read-only stored SalePrice (distinct, never averaged), purchase amount (CostPrice x Qty, live from the draft input while editing), stored SaleAmount, and Qty; wholly missing amounts display as unknown rather than zero and partially sourced amounts are labelled partial
purchaseCostManagement.identity: PnlKey + positive ProdKey + normalized Unit + IsCustom; if ProdKey is absent, exact whitespace-normalized ItemName + Unit + IsCustom
purchaseCostManagement.writeScope: only matching WebRaumPnlItem CostPrice/CostSource and parent WebRaumPnl UpdatedBy/UpdatedAt
purchaseCostManagement.concurrency: client itemKey+old CostPrice snapshot must equal locked current rows; stale scope or values returns 409 without partial save
purchaseCostManagement.zeroAndEmpty: explicit 0 is a valid saved cost; empty clears CostPrice to NULL and excludes the item from P&L totals
purchaseCostManagement.learning: WebRaumCostPrice is preserved so a historical week edit never changes the next import default
